question: Does generalization improve more from additional independent participants or from additional strides per existing participant?
fixed_evaluation_dataset: twente_expanded_alignment_v1 approved windows and deduplicated matched strides
outer_evaluation: One fixed held-out participant, evaluated on all approved expanded strides for that participant.
note_on_six: Six training participants cannot be evaluated on an independent participant because only six approved participants exist.

stride_budgets.OLD_SCALE: For each training participant, randomly sample the number of strides present in the original 460-stride dataset.
stride_budgets.EXPANDED_ALL: Use every approved expanded stride for each selected training participant.

alpha_selection: Nested subject-disjoint LOSO using training participants only; highest inner mean Macro F1, ties choose larger alpha.
metrics: force-defined landing within one native 33-fps frame
force-defined landing within two native 33-fps frames
candidate recall over all eligible force contacts in approved windows
candidate count per eligible force contact
statistics: Paired participant bootstrap on the six held-out participant deltas; stride-level resampling is forbidden.
attempt_ledger_entry: Attempt after twente_expanded_alignment_v1; does not authorize replacing the frozen current model.
